subject: [PATCH v4 03/13] mm/khugepaged: rename mthp_present_ptes bitmap to eligible_ptes

2026-09-28.patch_summary: This patch renames the bitmap 'mthp_present_ptes' in the mm/khugepaged module to 'eligible_ptes'. The name change reflects that a set bit in this bitmap indicates not only that a PTE is present, but also that it has passed various checks. This change does not introduce any functional changes and is intended to improve clarity of the code.
